_comment: Regions for the World/US/Tier-1 switch. 'world' = every country in the export. Edit the lists, then run `make build-data`.

world.label: World (sum of all countries in the export, up to 112)

tier1.label: Tier-1 countries (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, IE, DE, FR, NL, BE, AT, CH, LU, SE, NO, DK, FI, JP, KR, SG)

asia.label: Asia: East, South-East, South and Central Asia (JP, KR, CN, TW, HK, MO, TH, VN, ID, MY, SG, PH, KH, LA, MM, IN, PK, BD, LK, KZ, UZ); Middle East not included
